Prices

One honest note about cost

Implant cost depends on your scan — bone, grafts and the number of implants all change it. That is why DENTL publishes a downloadable Price List rather than a single figure that would mislead half its patients. Ask for the list, then book a consult for a plan priced to your mouth.

Questions

Before you book

What is All-Teeth-On-Four?

A full arch of fixed teeth supported on four implants, for patients who have lost most or all teeth in that arch.

Do I need a bone graft or sinus graft?

Only if your 3D scan shows it. Bone augmentation and sinus grafts are part of the practice's implant services, and your plan will say plainly whether you need one.

Is sedation available?

Yes, sedation is offered for implant treatment.

How much will my implants cost?

Cost depends on your scan and plan. DENTL publishes a downloadable Price List; request it through the booking form, then get a plan priced to your mouth at consult.

When are you open?

Monday to Friday 8am–5pm. Saturday and Sunday closed.
